answer: Each newcomer claims a ledge on the registry, needing a quorum of five unrelated neighbors staking 20 credits. A neighbor may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 2,500 neighbors and 170,000 locked versus 40,000 rewards. The five vouches form a vine. Star-shaped vines and rented-neighbor rings are flagged on the public trellis. Proven fakes burn the bond and five stakes; an honest agent pays 70 once.
